## Temporal interpretation

Each label uses the adjusted close observed on the rebalance date and the adjusted close exactly the configured number of market sessions later.

The first realized return occurs on the first session strictly after the rebalance date. Therefore, the target does not overlap with features calculated at the rebalance close.

A passing report confirms mechanical temporal and cross-sectional consistency. It does not remove the documented survivorship bias of the initial universe.
